key_facts: Nearly 9,700 National Guard troops have deployed to Washington, D.C. since Aug. 11, 2025 under the 'Make DC Safe and Beautiful' mission ordered by President Trump.
Guardsmen provided 788 medical assists, reunited 43 lost children, intervened in 262 fights, and administered Narcan 325 times, per Brig. Gen. Leland Blanchard.

The Congressional Budget Office estimates the D.C. deployment costs $55 million per month, and a new estimate provided to Sen. Elizabeth Warren's office projects another $1.4 billion in costs through January 2029.
A $292 million contract was awarded in July to lodging company Placemakr to move Guard troops from hotels into apartments, expected to save about $90 million.
A May Niskanen Center study found the Guard deployment correlated with decreased property crime but no change in violent crime trends.
